tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, including development builds, going forward. Development and testing that need a certificate the system does not already trust use self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
